rows.procedure: Run the 30-minute round-two stress session of UA-F13 (levels opened, strings plucked and tuned with peg drags and the panel, crossings tested, actions undone and redone, the camera orbited, levels retried and replayed in a loop) at automatic levels; the campaign samples the footprint and the thermal state.

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner plucks strings, drags pegs, taps the goal island and step pips and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; a tap under 10 points and 0.5 s on a string chooses it and auditions it without spending an action; a drag of 16 points or more from an unlocked string previews the peg (one peg per 24 points, clamped to 1 … 12) and tunes exactly once on release when the peg differs; a tap on the goal island or a step pip while playing sends exactly one test; a double tap on empty space restores the authored camera.
rows.procedure: Tap a string to pluck it, drag along an unlocked string to tune its peg, tap the goal island or a step pip to test the crossing, orbit the camera with two fingers and double-tap empty space on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Touch feel and touch-to-frame latency

rows.procedure: Turn the Sound toggle on and play a level to a win and to a failure with the haptics switch on, including one refused action (a tune of a locked string); pluck strings to hear their audition; observe the strings' ambient sound and the selection, success, warning and error haptics.
